content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-20|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-works-13|Stripe Alternatives]] for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-14|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

The absence of accessible payment gateways forces many digital sellers to rely on inferior alternatives, resulting in lost sales and revenue. However, with the emergence of no-KYC payment gateways like NOWPayments, creators can now sell their digital products without the need for traditional payment processors, thereby avoiding exorbitant fees and platform restrictions. For instance, Gumroad charges a 10% fee on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%, retaining $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack relies on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This infrastructure enables automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, ensuring that digital creators maintain control over their sales and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks enable full control over sales and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can start by selecting a hosting platform and backend logic provider, followed by setting up an order storage solution and integrating a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, creators can instantly download and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring a secure and efficient sales process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments charges a minimal 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about the kit and start building your own stack today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, configure a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, and test your stack to ensure seamless functionality. With these components in place, you can start selling your digital products with full control over sales and customer data.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a no-KYC payment gateway?
A no-KYC payment gateway is a payment processor that does not require know-your-customer (KYC) verification, enabling creators to receive crypto payments without platform restrictions.
How does NOWPayments work?
NOWPayments is a no-KYC payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee, enabling creators to receive crypto payments with minimal transaction costs.
What is a sovereign digital commerce stack?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that enables digital creators to sell their products online with full control over sales and customer data, without relying on traditional payment processors.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack to sell ebooks?
Yes, a sovereign digital commerce stack can be used to sell ebooks and other digital products, providing a secure and efficient sales process with full control over sales and customer data.
